column1: # The property list: every behaviour the engine BRANCHES on, and the fixture that
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. A test's input domain is not the arguments it passes, it is
# every property the code discriminates on -- and a fixture set is only as good as the
# list of properties it was partitioned over. Nothing in this tree wrote that list
# down, so "does the differential cover Chess960?" was a question nobody could answer
# without reading four directories. Now it is a row, and a row that stops being true
# WHAT THE GATE CAN AND CANNOT CHECK. It checks that the OWNER exists, that the
# FIXTURE exists, and that the WITNESS still matches inside the fixture -- so a
# fixture that stops presenting its property (the option line deleted, the position
# rewritten, the test renamed) reddens. It CANNOT check that presenting the property
# exercises the owner's branch: that needs coverage, which this tree does not collect.
# Read a row as "this fixture is where that property is presented", never as "that
#   property  the thing the engine branches on, in kebab-case
#   owner     the source file that branches on it (must exist)
#   fixture   the file that presents it (must exist)
#   witness   an extended regex that MUST match inside the fixture
# Adding a fixture without adding a row is a gate failure, in both directions: a
# property with no fixture is an untested branch, and a case file under no property is
# a fixture nobody can say what it represents.
